sources.title: Crossref ASPLOS 2023 Volume 3 metadata query
supports: Publisher-deposited metadata for 54 official main-program papers in ASPLOS 2023 Volume 3. The same proceedings query exposes two one-page keynote abstracts, which were audited and excluded as non-main material.

notes: Enumerated 128 unique DOI-linked main-track papers across 27 numbered technical sessions and three official proceedings volumes.
Three keynotes, one WACI block, and two poster-session blocks were excluded as non-main program material; lightning talks and posters duplicate main papers and were not added separately.

Volume 3 additionally contains two one-page archival keynote abstracts (DOIs 10.1145/3582016.3587050 and 10.1145/3582016.3587051), both excluded because the official program labels them keynotes rather than main technical papers.

All ML-themed papers expose a material architecture, compiler, runtime, communication, scheduling, storage, training, inference, or hardware/software co-design mechanism; no paper was excluded as ML-only.
Matched 19 papers to author-deposited archival Zenodo artifact records.
Resolved three duplicate Zenodo artifact candidates by retaining the latest or most complete deposit: two extra TREC records and one extra database-constraint artifact record were not attached.
Excluded artifact-search hits for ASPLOS 2024 Volume 4, ASPLOS 2026, and a TeraHeap paper-copy deposit because they were not artifacts for the official ASPLOS 2023 main-program boundary.
Captured all 128 official lightning-talk links, 76 publisher-deposited PDF links, 32 arXiv alternates, and 11 open repository copies.
Recorded 37 official-program versus Crossref title-rendering differences while preserving the official program title and stable initialized ID.
Nine official ASPLOS 2023 Volume 1 papers retain their exact publisher-deposited 2022-12-19 print date, reflecting publication before the March 2023 conference.
No duplicate DOI, duplicate canonical title, paper-ID collision, or proposed alias was found.
